chunks: And in the narration of Abū Baṣīr, from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
"My father, عليه السلام, used to fasten his expenses upon his belly, securing them with it, for indeed that is the completion of his hajj."

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abū Baṣīr, the narrator of this report
key_terms.تَمَامُ: the completion or perfection of something
key_terms.يَسْتَوْثِقُ: he would make secure or ensure safety

ai.seo_question: Is securing one’s money and provisions during hajj considered part of properly completing the pilgrimage?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Imam’s father, عليه السلام, would secure his travel funds carefully during hajj. It indicates practical care in managing one’s expenses and belongings as part of properly completing the pilgrimage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2646 - In a narration from Abu Basir, from Imam (as), he said:
"My father (as) used to tie his money securely around his waist, as it was part of completing his Hajj."
